newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds fall, nearing attractive levels.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds fall, nearing attractive levels.

text.p: Argentine bonds were lower late morning Monday, as the market continued Friday's slide triggered by a slump in U.S. Treasuries.
But traders said they did not think the market would fall much more, with prices approaching levels seen attractive enough to lure investors back into the market.
"There might be some more slight declines, but it will rise again," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's Par Brady bond was down 3/4 at 74-1/4 after falling 1-1/4 on Friday, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was down $0.33 at 118.50.
Another trader reckoned that "it is not yet attractive to enter but in the end the market still looks strong."
Players reported that activity was quiet in the morning.
